title: SB2429 (2018 Regular): RELATING TO GUARDS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2018/bills/SB2429_.HTM; sha256 563c671d4a80761a045058ede3b0462a29f88dc51a534766ff67f7a98ef7351f)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The rest of the bill (prior-employment background checks, agency disclosures in SECTIONS 1-3) supports the firearm bar and is not quoted. Amendments after filing are not in the text read.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 463-8): (6) If granted a license, have a restriction placed on the individual's license that prevents the individual from possessing a firearm in the course of employment if the individual has been discharged from employment as a law enforcement officer due to poor employment standing; and
SECTION 2 (HRS 463-8): (4) Be prohibited from possessing a firearm in the course of employment if the individual has been discharged from employment as a law enforcement officer due to poor employment standing; and
SECTION 4 (HRS 463-10.5): (5) Agree to refrain from possessing a firearm in the course of employment if the individual has been discharged from employment as a law enforcement officer due to poor employment standing.
